definitions.gloss: steep slope; steep hill; steep incline
definitions.explanation: A road or path with a sharp incline or decline. Used for slopes that are notably steep and difficult to climb or descend.

examples.japanese: {急坂|きゅうざか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{急坂|きゅうざか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ。
examples.english: This steep slope is impossible by bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{急坂|きゅうざか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧になっている。
examples.english: Since there are steep hills all the way from the station to my house, my daily commute serves as good exercise.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (steep/sudden) + ⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧ (slope/hill). Can also be read as きゅうはん in more formal or technical contexts, though きゅうざか is the standard reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急坂|きゅうざか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a steep hill
- {急坂|きゅうざか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧: to go down a steep hill
- {急坂|きゅうざか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: steep hills continue
- {急坂|きゅうざか}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution: steep slope (road sign)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧: sloping road — any road on a slope, not necessarily steep
- ⟦{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}→上り坂：16376_noborizaka⟧: uphill slope — going up, any gradient
- ⟦{下|くだ}り{坂|ざか}→下り坂：16377_kudarizaka⟧: downhill slope — going down, any gradient
- {勾配|こうばい}: gradient/grade — technical term for slope angle
